**2. Dead `h3.sh` domain → live docs only** (`README.md`, `docs/guide.md`, `docs/migration.md`)

- Live docs: `[h3.sh](https://h3.sh/)` → `[get-h3.github.io/h3](https://get-h3.github.io/h3/)` (README Documentation section, guide step 4, migration "Why migrate" + step 4).

**3. Dead `pip install hermes-h3-shim` in copy-paste code blocks → source install in-block** (README/guide/migration):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/get-h3/shim
cd shim && pip install -e .
cd ..
```

**4. README quickstart — clone sibling repos before `cd`** (README + guide):

```bash
# 2. Clone the sibling sdk-go repo, then start the Go echo harness
#    (sdk-go is NOT part of shim — it must be cloned first)
git clone https://github.com/get-h3/sdk-go
cd sdk-go/examples/echo && go run .
```

The scaffold block (`cd h3-harness-go`) is correct as-is — that directory is created by `hermes-h3 scaffold`.
